name: Powell's (V3)
author: NUMU
description: Powell's (V3) — a lavender bookshop storefront built for used and rare stock. A filter rail faceted from your own product options, a book page that sells COPIES rather than titles (each variant priced with its own condition and shelf), staff-pick notes signed by a bookseller, and hand-drawn marginalia you can switch off.
description_ar: باول (V3) — متجر كتب بلون بنفسجي متعمل للكتب المستعملة والنادرة. شريط فلاتر بيتبني من اختيارات منتجاتك، وصفحة كتاب بتبيع نسخة مش عنوان (كل متغير بسعره وحالته والفرع اللي فيه)، وملاحظات مكتوبة بإمضاء البائع، ورسومات يدوية تقدر تقفلها.

settings.heading: A million books, and one of them is yours.
settings.body: New, used and rare on the same shelf. Come in for one book, leave with four.

settings.heading: Dark Romance After Midnight
settings.body: Morally grey heroes, dangerous bargains and the kind of ending you read with the lights off.

settings.heading: Start here
settings.body: Three books our booksellers hand to anyone who asks where to begin.

settings.heading: What we're pressing into people's hands
settings.body: Every book on this page passed through a bookseller's hands before it reached the shelf. We read them, we price them, and we tell you honestly what shape they're in.

settings.heading: Every used book is graded by a person
settings.body: We open every copy, check every page, and tell you exactly what shape it is in.

settings.heading: Collector's shelf
settings.body: Special editions, sprayed edges and the copies worth keeping on the good shelf.

settings.heading: One letter a month, about books worth your evenings
settings.body: New arrivals, staff picks and the occasional reading list — never more than once a month.
